# Warm, rambling, tangents. Father died of a heart attack, life insurance claim denied.
• {P2:Sam Whitaker}

It's {P1:Maria Lopez}, {P1:M-A-R-I-A}, and {P1:Lopez} like the singer, but no relation, I wish. My maiden name was Santos but nobody uses that anymore.

Oh, we moved last year. It's {A1:4417 Alder Creek Drive, Tacoma, WA 98402}. Before that we were across town, near the old bakery, you wouldn't know it.

Perfect. Tell me a little about your family before we get to the claim.
• {P1:Maria Lopez}
Okay, so, I'm married, my husband is {P3:Hector}, we have been married thirty one years in June. We have two kids, my daughter {P4:Grace} who's thirty, she is the one who set up the email, and my son {P5:Mateo}, he lives in Phoenix now.

Lovely. And I understand you recently lost your father?
• {P1:Maria Lopez}
Yes. Oh, this is hard. My father, {P6:Roberto Lopez}, he passed in March. He was eighty three. It was his heart, it was so sudden, he was out in the garden, he loved his tomatoes, and then, um, my mother found him.
• {P2:Sam Whitaker}
I'm very sorry for your loss. Take your time.
• {P1:Maria Lopez}
No, no, I'm okay. My mother, {P7:Carmen}, she's staying with my sister {P8:Elena} now in Yakima. {P7:Carmen} can't be alone, she gets confused in the evenings.
• {P2:Sam Whitaker}
Understood. So the insurance claim. What policy are we talking about?
• {P1:Maria Lopez}
Papa had a life insurance policy with Pacific Mutual, two hundred thousand dollars, he paid on it for like thirty years. And they denied it. They said the policy lapsed in January because a payment bounced.

Who handled the claim on their side?

A woman named {P9:Denise Park}. Very polite, very, you know, robotic. She kept saying "per the terms." I spoke with {P9:Denise} three times and each time a different story.

Did you receive anything in writing?

A letter, yes. I have it in a folder. Signed by a Mr. {P10:Aldridge}, I think he is a vice president or something.

My mother. {P7:Carmen}. But Papa always said it was for all of us, he wanted {P5:Mateo} to have help with the house.

Do you know if the bank notified your father about the bounced payment?
• {P1:Maria Lopez}
That's the thing! My sister {P8:Elena} looks at his account and she says there was plenty of money in there. We think the bank made a mistake. Or maybe Papa's address was wrong, he got mail at the old place, the one on Fir Lane, honestly I don't know.
